title: A default value does not make a parameter keyword-compatible
applies_when: A Python hook dispatcher, constructor adapter or cached call plan divides parameters into positional and keyword groups based only on whether they have defaults.
lesson: Keep default presence separate from positional-only versus positional-or-keyword calling kind. Pluggy's new explicit-value forwarding classified defaulted positional-only hook parameters as kwargs and raised TypeError through the public PluginManager API. Test required and defaulted positional-only controls, supplying only a later optional value, mixed keyword-compatible parameters, falsy values and wrapper/call_extra paths. Fill earlier default gaps only when needed to reach a supplied positional argument; leave trailing omitted defaults implicit so decorators still observe omission. Cache metadata outside a hot loop when appropriate, but inspect the same unwrapped callable and avoid evaluating annotations just to obtain argument kinds.
avoid_when: Do not infer a bug from a helper field name: a downstream binder may already normalize arguments. Confirm that the signature is supported and trace the actual call. Keyword-only support/rejection is a separate API decision. This case validates one Pluggy source revision and proposed repair, not every adapter, runtime mutation of function defaults, performance benefit or maintainer acceptance. Native package/source identity and existing-suite baselines remain necessary.

evidence.note: Introduces explicit hook call value > hookspec default > hookimpl default precedence, establishing the intended default-forwarding behavior rather than assuming it from Python alone.
Public-API reproduction on pinned main: defaulted positional-only hook parameters raise TypeError; required parameters work. Independently reproduced on Windows/Linux.

Submitted regression matrix: 13 failures/9 controls on unmodified main; proposed fix passes the full241-test suite on Windows3.12/3.14 and Linux3.12. Includes omission-sensitive decorated calls. Submitted evidence, not merged/CI acceptance or a performance comparison.
